selection_policy.targeted: 40 manually selected v5 R-to-D mismatches plausibly relevant to negation target, accompanying explanation, action inference or uptake. Ambiguous and parsing-confounded cases are diagnostic candidates, not adjudicated errors.
selection_policy.relevant_control: 80 previously consensus-correct R/D records: 8 per label per language, enriched for multiword negation plus ownership/deixis/preference/action words in the target or nearest three turns. Features are candidate retrieval, not semantic adjudication.
selection_policy.broad_control: 80 other consensus-correct records: 16 per language. Quotas per language: 4 R, 4 D, 4 Nonexistence (including Nonpossession), 2 Excluded, 2 Uncoded. Sparse classes are filled deterministically from remaining classes and documented.
selection_policy.eligibility: dev_train only, both human labels present and equal after Nonpossession collapse, neither human repetition Yes.
selection_policy.dependence: One record per target utterance; at most two selected records in any 20-observed-turn window within a transcript/half. Turn ranks come from the union of all dev_train context windows and targets, not global numeric line gaps. Missing intervening turns make this cap conservative. This caps clustering, not a claim of independence.
selection_policy.limitations: Training-only, purposively enriched diagnostic. No population accuracy, causal prevalence or held-out generalization estimate. No composite-score promotion threshold.

selection.selection_reason: Manual mechanism-relevant training mismatch; interpretation remains a hypothesis.
